title: Prove the sharp zero-primary cap spectrum at every idempotent rank
body:
## Summary

Resolve #5928's local chain-cap question over every characteristic-two field. If A+B=D, D is idempotent of rank k in dimension r, and both zero-primary chain indices are at most m, the sharp maximum of z(A)+z(B) is min(2r-(k mod 2),r+(r-k)*ell), where ell is the largest odd integer <=m. Binary constructions attain every case; a corollary gives the exact globally nilpotent existence criterion.

Credit Nick Petalas/#5928 for the odd-block construction and original question, and JoyboyBrian/#5507 for the caller model. Canonical base and source pin: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a. Exact source hashes and classical context are recorded in the package.

## Evidence

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/capped-shared-block-spectrum/verify.py
```

Expected: PASS_CAPPED_SHARED_BLOCK_SPECTRUM. All six registered normal/optimized and read-only portable replays passed. Author checks cover 329,780 binary pairs, every rank/cap through dimension four and 13,090 attaining constructions through dimension 33. Separate literal-kernel and packed-field engines agree, including all 1,049,352 F4 pairs through dimension three. Fifteen rejecting controls and independent proof/code reviews passed.

## Limitations and next questions

No new κ. Universal quantifiers rest on the written proof; finite tests are corroboration. #5507's required length-two native chain does not impose an upper cap: its helper can extend the chain. Actual caller applicability, physical realization and complete supplier accounting remain open. Full-history validation was unavailable in the shallow checkout.

## Attribution

@CubeJerry, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. [Proof, pins, reviews and remaining obligations](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/48233eac64d0645e385407bee33195d78deb2e52/research/capped-shared-block-spectrum). No human, proof-kernel or general literature-priority acceptance claimed.
